+def get_isbn_10_and_13(isbns: str | list[str]) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    """Return valid ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 values from IA metadata."""
+    if isinstance(isbns, str):
+        isbns = [isbns]
+    isbn_10, isbn_13 = [], []
+    for isbn in isbns or []:
+        if not isinstance(isbn, str):
+            continue
+        value = re.sub(r"[\s-]", "", isbn)
+        if len(value) == 10 and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{9}[0-9Xx]", value):
+            isbn_10.append(value.upper())
+        elif len(value) == 13 and value.isdigit():
+            isbn_13.append(value)
+    return isbn_10, isbn_13

+def get_publisher_and_place(
+    publishers: str | list[str],
+) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    """Separate IA publisher values into publisher names and places."""
+    if isinstance(publishers, str):
+        publishers = [publishers]
+    names, places = [], []
+    for value in publishers or []:

+            continue
+        parts = value.split(":", 1)
+        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0].strip() and parts[1].strip():
